gloss: to grow accustomed through practice; to get used to doing

definitions.gloss: to grow accustomed to (something) through repeated learning or practice
definitions.explanation: A compound verb combining {習|なら}う (to learn) with {慣|な}れる (to get used to). Describes reaching a state where a skill or routine feels natural after enough practice.

examples.japanese: {習|なら}い{慣|な}れた⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: I take a route I'm used to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{習|なら}い{慣|な}れた。
examples.english: I use it every day, so I've gotten used to operating it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{習|なら}い{慣|な}れる⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: Keigo takes time to get used to, but eventually it comes out naturally.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧ (to learn) + ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧ (to grow accustomed). Conjugates as an ichidan verb like ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧. The literary register is mild — common in writing about skills, languages, and work routines.

USAGE:
- Past form most common: {習|なら}い{慣|な}れた is used attributively ({習|なら}い{慣|な}れた⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧, {習|なら}い{慣|な}れた⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧).
- Predicative {習|なら}い{慣|な}れる appears in writing about gradually mastering something.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: to get used to — broader and more common; covers any kind of habituation
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to be acquired (as a skill) — focuses on the skill becoming a permanent part of oneself
- ⟦{使|つか}い{慣|な}れる→使い慣れる：07877_tsukainareru⟧: to get used to using something — parallel compound for tools or systems
